conditions: A shopper navigates to a product detail page and clicks Add to cart
items.expected: A confirmation is displayed; the cart icon in the header updates to show the number of items added.

conditions: A shopper adds a product to the cart, then adds another product to the cart
items.expected: After each add-to-cart action the cart icon count increments; after two adds the cart icon shows 2.

conditions: A shopper opens the cart and changes a line item's quantity
items.expected: The line's total price updates to reflect the new quantity; the cart total also updates to reflect the change.

conditions: A shopper opens the cart and removes a line item
items.expected: The line is no longer present in the cart; the cart total updates to exclude the removed line's amount.

conditions: The cart page is open with at least one item
items.expected: axe-core reports zero violations for WCAG A/AA rules on the cart page.

excluded.reason: This story covers adding products to the cart and adjusting quantities — it has no login, session, or account-data-exposure behaviour. There is nothing here that implies a security-observable threat through the browser.

TOOL-21 (admin product search) does not touch shopper cart behaviour. TOOL-20 (billing address) belongs to the checkout story TOOL-16, not cart management. Neither open bug has any test surface in this story.
Admin product search functionality — unrelated to shopper cart or quantity management in this story.
Billing address step in checkout — belongs to TOOL-16 (checkout), not this story's cart behaviour.
